note: Built from the Forgejo fork's sparse-codepoint-index branch (unicode-shared-font plus a paged per-codepoint glyph index: the fork's CMake applies imgui-smash/patches/imgui/0001-paged-codepoint-index.patch to a copy of the Dear ImGui submodule; imgui_smash_font_use_paged_index, called by Deluxe before imgui_smash_init, keeps the overlay fonts' index in 256-codepoint pages where glyphs exist; font stats version 3). unicode-shared-font: the NVN backend honours ImGui's texture requests; the system shared fonts are merged after JetBrains Mono's ASCII subset; a static set of ASCII, Latin-1 Supplement and Latin Extended-A is rasterized once, and the dynamic set holds only the other characters on screen, dropped between frames once they leave it; Alpha8 atlas 512x128 growing to at most 1024x1024. Two clean builds produced this archive byte for byte. Member mtime, uid, and gid are zero.
